decisions.reason: Distinguishes clipboard/draft occurrence offsets from detect-coordinate spans, including chips expanding to clipboardText but occupying one U+FFFC in detectText.

Locates snapshot.draft.length in add and explains first success versus second failure as clipboard length overshooting detect span, producing insertReference false and the misleading changed-composer toast.

Traces removal through occurrence.offset/length passed to consumeToken, ignored false result, unconditional records.delete, live occurrence remaining, unavailable dock label, and composer chip staying.
Derives subtracting preceding chip length minus one, applies it to insertion and removal, uses a one-detect-character removal span, keeps draftRev, and gates record deletion on consume success.
Proposes successive pastes with both chips present and a multi-chip removal where the removed chip disappears from composer, dock, and records while the other chips survive.
